arguments.command:
python -c "
from more_itertools import relative_seek, seekable
import io

# Test R1: relative_seek with seekable stream
f = io.BytesIO(b'Hello, World!')
s = seekable(f)
print('Initial position:', s.tell())
data = s.read(5)
print('After reading 5 bytes, position:', s.tell())
data = relative_seek(s, -3)  # Seek back 3 from current position
print('After relative_seek(-3), position:', s.tell())
data = s.read(3)
print('Read after seeking:', data)
"
